{
  "proposition": "The proposed recurrence fits every supplied observation. Conditional on it, x_n=5+3n+max(0,n−2) for every nonnegative integer n, and x_5=23. Fit does not establish the mechanism or empirically confirm x_5.",
  "evidence": "For the same invented relay, supplied observations are x_0=5, x_1=8, x_2=11, x_3=15, and x_4=19. Their increments are 3, 3, 4, 4, exactly as the note proposes.",
  "prior_commitment_status": "Retain the earlier arithmetic, conditional prediction of 14 under the original rule, and its subsequent falsification by x_3=15. Earlier consistency and missing-observation claims remain descriptions of earlier evidence. The new hypothesis does not restore the falsified universal increment-3 rule.",
  "calculation": "Summing n increments gives 3n plus max(0,n−2) indicator contributions. Thus x_5=5+15+3=23. The false twin 5+4n predicts 5,9,13,17,21 for n=0,…,4; x_1=8 already falsifies it.",
  "limitation": "No observation beyond x_4 or mechanism proof is supplied. A measured x_5 unequal to 23 would falsify the new recurrence; agreement would support it without proving its universal validity or physical mechanism."
}
